purpose: RQ1 Main 2: session-held-out evaluation of frozen v3 (primary) against frozen v2 on 60 newly sampled, independently human-labeled decision points. Recorded before any Main 2 model call.
git_head_meaning: Base HEAD at record creation, not the commit containing this record; exact file contents are pinned below
decided_by: Yuan Tian (2026-11-20): common 300,000-byte request budget for every Main 2 config; symmetric run matrix v2+v3 x 27B+9B x seeds 329/330/331

frozen_and_unchanged.v3_primary_rule: option (a) from outputs/rq1-v3/preregistration.json: qwen38-27b-fp8 seed 329, raw valid output, no voting or confidence filtering

budget_amendment.scope: Every configs/main2 config (v2/v3, both models, all seeds). The only difference from configs/v2 and configs/v3.
budget_amendment.reason: M2-046 (~290 KB) and M2-047 (~222 KB) requests exceed 200,000 bytes for both contracts; 300,000 admits all 60 items for both contracts. Chosen from input sizes only, not from labels or model output.
budget_amendment.main1: Main 1 configs, failures (including M1-009) and metrics stay unchanged; no Main 1 rerun is authorized by this record.

sample.items_location: Not tracked in Git (redacted, not guaranteed anonymous). Byte-identical to the annotators' evidence; copied to the cluster and checked against this hash by the sbatch main2 stage.
sample.enrichment: B2-B4 target turns pass frozen lexical/structural opportunity proxies; B1 unscreened. Not a population-uniform sample.

heldout.note: Session-held-out only; 16 of 60 items come from participants seen in earlier rounds (see sampling-audit.json).

sample.participants: 39 participants; 44 items from 23 unseen participants, 16 from 16 previously seen participants; at most 4 items per participant. Session-held-out, NOT participant-disjoint.

human_reference.process: Two annotators (A, B) labeled all 60 independently under v0.2 without model suggestions. Raw agreement and kappa were computed before any discussion. The 9 disagreements were adjudicated by an anonymous third-party judge in two steps (independent label first, then blinded Rater X/Y view with per-row random order). The judge's texts were pasted to the coordinator, who stated the judge wrote them; workbooks were transcribed from those texts. Original A/B labels unchanged.
human_reference.B_missing_confidence_note: B's 4 initially blank confidence fields were filled by B before adjudication; labels unaffected.

run_matrix.hardware: SC jag-standard, 1x RTX 6000 Ada 48GB per job, same vLLM runtime and arguments as the v3 Main 1 runs

token_preflight.note: Chat-templated system prompt + canonical payload with generation prompt and enable_thinking=True, pinned tokenizers from the offline HF cache; run on a compute node.

analysis.primary: v3 qwen38-27b-fp8 seed 329 vs adjudicated; comparator v2 qwen38-27b-fp8 seed 329
metrics: coverage = valid outputs / 60 with failure types
FMR = valid predicted 0 with nonzero/N/A reference / valid predictions with nonzero/N/A reference (numerator/denominator shown)
reference-zero detection: valid predicted 0 among reference 0 (count/denominator)
analysis.intervals: 95% percentile item bootstrap, 10000 resamples, same method as Main 1; ignores participant clustering (disclosed)
secondary: common-valid v2/v3 comparison on items valid in both
options (b) majority vote and (c) high-confidence-zero as defined in the v3 preregistration
analysis.separation: Main 2 is reported separately; its FMR is never pooled with Main 1 (different sampling, opportunity-enriched).
analysis.interpretation: Lower FMR is read together with coverage and reference-zero detection; dropped failures alone are not improvement. No automatic RQ2 contract switch.

failure_policy: Invalid, truncated or budget-rejected outputs stay failed; no repair, resampling, manual journal edit or conversion to N/A. Preemption interruptions are resumed only for pending calls with identical frozen inputs and recorded as incidents.
incidents_and_deviations: Token preflight was first started on the SC login node, where it stalled on NFS reads; it was killed before producing output and rerun as a CPU-only Slurm job on a compute node.
Byte preflight was run locally (no tokenizer needed).
